text:
alex: FYI opened PR #2345 to add per-customer toggles with contract gating + VIP allowlist. Looking for rollout plan and guardrails. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/2345

priya: Quick questions — default should be OFF for all enterprises unless explicitly allowed by contract or in allowlist. Also need a webhook when a customer is toggled for legal ops.

sam: How are we treating VIPs? contract says gold-tier customers should get immediate access. Do they bypass canary?

alex: Plan proposal: VIPs are in a VIP allowlist -> always ON. Non-VIP enterprise customers get canary by customer_id hashing + manual contract whitelist. Behavior: contract_gate consults billing metadata, then allowlist, then hash-rollout. Example config below.

alex: ```json
{
  "flags": {
    "new_feature": {
      "default": false,
      "customer_allowlist": ["cust_123", "cust_456"],
      "vip_allowlist": ["cust_vipA"],
      "rollout_percentage": 10,
      "contract_gate": true
    }
  }
}
```

jess: Make sure each decision includes decision_reason in logs and a matched_rule field. Also emit metric labels: flag_source=(allowlist|contract|hash).

priya: Admin console needs per-customer override and an audit trail. Who owns the UI work?

alex: I'll do backend + API changes. @jess can you take console? @sam can you review RBAC and audit logging?

sam: I can. Suggest we add a grace_period on contract toggles so toggles don't flip mid billing cycle — e.g., grace_period_days: 7.

jess: :thumbsup: I'll sketch UI flows. Safety note: before enabling for a customer, run a validation job against staging to ensure model variants/quantization configs are compatible.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for flag 'new_feature' at 2025-10-05T22:00Z to 10% customers. Source: PR #2345. Staging checks: passed.

alex: One more: fallback if customer record missing? default OFF, log an event and create a follow-up ticket for account team.

priya: Also add response header X-Redwood-Feature:new_feature=true|false to help downstream instrumentation.

alex: Added both items to the PR description and tests. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning and kick off manual canary.

jess: no objections from me — please add a short rollback runbook (steps + DB cleanup) in the PR.

alex: Will add runbook section before merge. Thanks everyone!
